description: This file defines the ServiceEcaRule class, which models rules for event-condition-action (ECA) logic related to services in the Apache OFBiz framework. It manages conditions, actions, and execution logic triggered by specific service events.

classes.name: ServiceEcaRule
classes.description: Represents a rule that defines conditions and actions triggered by specific service events, facilitating event-driven processing within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: getShortDisplayName
methods.description: Returns a brief string combining service and event names for display purposes.

methods.name: getServiceName
methods.description: Returns the name of the service associated with this rule.

methods.name: getEventName
methods.description: Returns the name of the event that triggers this rule.

methods.name: getDefinitionLocation
methods.description: Returns the location of the rule definition (typically XML source).

methods.name: getEcaActionList
methods.description: Retrieves the list of actions to be executed when conditions are met.

methods.name: getEcaConditionList
methods.description: Retrieves the list of conditions that must evaluate to true for actions to proceed.

methods.name: eval
methods.description: Evaluates the rule: checks conditions; if true, executes actions and sets; filters execution based on failure/error flags and enable status.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Checks whether this rule is enabled.
